events.title: Found a $20 spot!
events.body: Crushed can, folded bill, same energy — twenty bucks just sitting there in the lot.

events.title: Loose cash in the nightstand
events.body: Last guest left a rumpled ten and a prayer card. Finders keepers in this economy.

events.title: Friend's fridge came through
events.body: Someone's roommate stocked up. Two cold ones with your name on them.
